Sau khi học xong môn học, sinh viên cần đạt được những yêu cầu sau:

- Trang bị kiến thức đầy đủ về Nhà nước và pháp luật theo quan điểm của chủ nghĩa Mác-Lênin, nắm vững quan điểm, chủ trương, chính sách của Đảng và Nhà nước được thể hiện trong những quy định của pháp luật.
- Có kỹ năng vận dụng giải quyết các tình huống pháp lý cơ bản trong đời sống để bảo vệ quyền và lợi ích hợp pháp của các chủ thể trong xã hội;
- Tuân thủ nguyên tắc “Sống và làm việc theo quy định của pháp luật”.
- Có khả năng cập nhật kiến thức mang tính thời sự trong lĩnh vực pháp lý; nâng cao ý thức pháp luật, ý thức công dân của sinh viên trong các hoạt động ở Trường và ngoài xã hội.


","en":"

After completing the course, students need to meet the following requirements:
- Be equipped with adequate knowledge of the State and law according to the Marxist-Leninist viewpoint, grasp the viewpoints, guidelines and policies of the Party and the State as reflected in the provisions of the law.
- Have the skills to apply and resolve basic legal situations in life to protect the rights and legitimate interests of subjects in society;
- Adhere to the principle of "Living and working according to the provisions of the law".
- Be able to update current knowledge in the legal field; raise legal awareness and civic awareness of students in activities at school and in society.

- Pháp luật Việt Nam Đại cương nêu và giải thích những khái niệm cơ bản về Nhà nước và pháp luật; Nguồn gốc, bản chất của Nhà nước và pháp luật; vai trò và giá trị xã hội của Nhà nước và pháp luật trong đời sống xã hội; Nội dung cơ bản về nguyên tắc và tổ chức bộ máy Nhà nước Cộng hòa xã hội chủ nghĩa Việt Nam.
- Nội dung cơ bản và những tình huống pháp lý liên quan đến pháp luật dân sự: đối tượng và phương pháp điều chỉnh, những nguyên tắc cơ bản của ngành luật dân sự; chủ thể quan hệ pháp luật dân sự; cùng những chế định cơ bản về tài sản, quyền đối với tài sản, hợp đồng và thừa kế.

- Nội dung cơ bản và những tình huống pháp lý liên quan đến pháp luật lao động: đối tượng và phương pháp điều chỉnh, những nguyên tắc cơ bản của ngành luật lao động; chủ thể quan hệ lao động; cùng những chế định cơ bản về quan hệ đào tạo nghề, quan hệ lao động, quan hệ thử việc, việc giao kết, thực hiện và chấm dứt quan hệ lao động.
- Nội dung cơ bản và những tình huống pháp lý liên quan đến pháp luật hình sự: căn cứ xác định tội phạm, cấu thành của tội phạm và trách nhiệm hình sự.

- Cung cấp những kiến thức cơ bản về Tố tụng Dân sự, Tố tụng Hình sự, Tố tụng Hành chính.
- Môn học nêu và giải thích những khái niệm cơ bản trong pháp luật hành chính, pháp luật kinh doanh, pháp luật bảo vệ môi trường, pháp luật phòng, chống tham nhũng: vấn đề đối tượng và phương pháp điều chỉnh, những nguyên tắc cơ bản, những chế định cụ thể được pháp luật hành chính, pháp luật kinh doanh, pháp luật bảo vệ môi trường, pháp luật phòng, chống tham nhũng bảo vệ.


","en":"

- Vietnamese Law Outline states and explains the basic concepts of the State and law; Origin and nature of the State and law; role and social value of the State and law in social life; Basic content on principles and organization of the State apparatus of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.

- Basic content and legal situations related to civil law: subjects and methods of regulation, basic principles of the civil law sector; subjects of civil law relations; and basic institutions on property, rights to property, contracts and inheritance.

- Basic content and legal situations related to labor law: subjects and methods of regulation, basic principles of the labor law sector; subjects of labor relations; and basic institutions on vocational training relations, labor relations, probationary relations, conclusion, implementation and termination of labor relations. - Basic content and legal situations related to criminal law: basis for determining crime, crime composition and criminal liability.

- Providing basic knowledge about Civil Procedure, Criminal Procedure, Administrative Procedure.
- The subject presents and explains basic concepts in administrative law, business law, environmental protection law, anti-corruption law: issues of subjects and methods of regulation, basic principles, specific regulations protected by administrative law, business law, environmental protection law, anti-corruption law.

- Các sinh viên sẽ được:
+ Hướng dẫn các văn bản quy phạm pháp luật trong quá trình học tập.
+ Giải đáp thắc mắc qua LMS
+ Sinh viên có khả năng tự học, chủ động trong những giải quyết những vấn đề thực tiễn.
- Tất cả sinh viên phải:
+ Tham gia ít nhất 80% số giờ hoạt động trên lớp và làm bài tập thảo luận/thực hành tại lớp (chiếm 20%).
+ Thực hiện bài tập lớn (BTL) theo nhóm và chủ đề dưới sự hướng dẫn của giảng viên (chiếm 30%)
+ Đọc tài liệu học tập, tài liệu tham khảo và chuẩn bị đầy đủ các chủ đề được quy định trong Đề cương môn học; nghiên cứu trước bài giảng về nội dung sẽ học trong tuần.
+ Sinh viên phải xem tất cả các video hướng dẫn học tập trong các tuần học và làm những bài quiz đạt từ 5 điểm trở lên.


","en":"

- Students will receive:

+ Instructions on legal documents during the learning process.
+ Answer questions via LMS
+ Students have the ability to self-study and be proactive in solving practical problems.
- All students must:
+ Participate in at least 80% of class activities and do discussion/practice exercises in class (accounting for 20%).
+ Carry out large assignments (BTL) in groups and topics under the guidance of instructors (accounting for 30%)
+ Read study materials, reference materials and fully prepare the topics specified in the course outline; Research before the lecture about the content you will learn during the week.
+ Students must watch all study guide videos during the school weeks and take quizzes to score 5 points or more.
